subject.title: Feishu: read image tool result loses media before final outbound payload

question: Which fix path should own trusted `read` image results that contain image blocks but no `details.path` for Feishu and shared channel delivery?
rationale: The remaining bug is clear, but the available PRs choose different media-boundary behavior, and local-path fallback can interact with sensitive path exposure concerns.

options.title: Make media-store delivery canonical
options.body: Land or repair the approach that saves pathless `read` image blocks as safe `media://inbound/...` references before queuing outbound delivery.

options.title: Rework local-arg fallback
options.body: Allow `path` or `file_path` fallback only with explicit trusted-root checks and safe failure text that never exposes raw local references.

options.title: Pause pending live proof
options.body: Keep both PRs open until one provides convincing Feishu read-image delivery proof and addresses the security-boundary concern.

recommendation.title: Make media-store delivery canonical
recommendation.body: Land or repair the approach that saves pathless `read` image blocks as safe `media://inbound/...` references before queuing outbound delivery.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged history owns the current agent media extraction and pending-tool-media queue surfaces.
